tldr.en: A talk to the 3LOGIC team on September 10, 2026, built on two ideas: believe, and hold fast to first principles. Belief is the source of passion, and passion is what lets a team keep going through difficulties that would make any rational person quit. AI is a once-in-fifteen-to-twenty-years opportunity, and the era is still undefined, so small teams are participants rather than spectators. They can bring IP to life for its owners, and offer consumers companionship and a chance to reflect on meaning as AI takes over more work. First principles come down to one question: what truly resonates with users? Rights, policy and cost are real constraints, but they should not define the product. When one path is blocked, find another way to create the same value, without disregarding the law or other people's rights.
tldr.hans: 2026 年 9 月 10 日对 3LOGIC 团队的讲话，核心只有两点：要相信，要把握第一性原理。相信带来热情，热情才能让人在任何理性的人都会放弃的困难中坚持下去。人工智能是大约每十五到二十年才出现一次的时代性机会，这个时代还远未被定义，小团队不是旁观者，而是参与者：让知识产权从静态走向有生命，为拥有者创造新的价值；在人工智能接手越来越多工作之际，为最终消费者提供陪伴，以及重新思考人生意义的机会。第一性原理归结为一个问题：我们到底靠什么打动用户？权利、政策、成本都是真实的约束，但不能让障碍定义产品；一条路走不通，就寻找另一条创造同样价值的路，但这绝不意味着可以无视法律和他人的权利。
